Use Case Description: Allows the Admin to authenticate and access the admin dashboard.
Allows the Admin to create, read, update, and delete product categories.
Allows the Admin to add new bakery products, update details, or remove them.
Allows the Admin to define the ingredients and quantities required to bake each product.
Allows the Admin to view and manage customer information (individuals and organizations).
Allows the Admin to add and manage information of raw material suppliers.
Allows the Admin to view and update raw ingredient details and stock thresholds.
Allows the Admin to import new stock from suppliers, update inventory, and record costs.
Allows the Admin to create daily baking tasks, calculate required ingredients, and assign them to bakers.
Allows the Admin to create discount codes and configure their usage rules (e.g. minimum order).
Provides a centralized summary view of the bakery's operational and financial metrics.
Displays revenue charts and statistics based on completed customer orders over time.
Displays the expenses incurred from importing ingredients via Goods Receipts.
Displays a log of completed production tasks and compares planned vs actual yields.
